steps: Create a free talent profile (Braintrust states about 20 minutes).
Complete the conversational AI skills interview and earn the Certified Braintrust Talent badge (ID-verified; certification within 1–2 days).
Get AI-matched to contract, full-time, part-time, or gig roles across engineering, design, product, data, marketing, and more.
Win a role and start earning — Braintrust charges talent $0 in fees, ever.
timing: Profile plus interview under an hour; certification in 1–2 days; matching begins after certification; 10k+ active roles listed.
